text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Wird die Lauge dann wieder mittels Verdampfung und Absorption von Wasser verdünnt, entsteht Wärme, mit der die Sorptionsspeicher-Wärmepumpe fast ohne zusätzliche elektrische Energie heizen kann.", "gist": "Diluting lye with water via evaporation and absorption generates heat, allowing the sorption heat pump to heat almost without extra electricity."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Sorptionsspeicher-Wärmepumpe", "gist": "Sorption heat pump"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Frauenfeld", "gist": "location in Switzerland"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "Zwei", "gist": "two"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Schweiz und in Deutschland", "gist": "Switzerland and Germany"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Zwei weitere, grössere Pilotanlagen in der Schweiz und in Deutschland werden in den nächsten Monaten folgen.", "gist": "Two larger pilot plants in Switzerland and Germany will follow in the next months."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Danach soll sich SeasOn erfolgreich auf dem Markt positionieren können.", "gist": "SeasOn is expected to successfully position itself on the market afterwards."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Kategorie Erneuerbare Energien", "gist": "Category: Renewable Energies"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Agri-PV in Buchs: Die Sonne beschert eine doppelte Ernte.", "gist": "Agri-PV in Buchs: The sun provides a double harvest."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Und Photovoltaikmodule braucht es, um Strom zu produzieren.", "gist": "Photovoltaic modules are needed to produce electricity."}]}
